description: A bearded man in a leather apron and rough shirt swings a hammer above a heavy wooden stump. On the stump a metal coin-striking die sits with a few silver coins, and more coins are stacked at the left and scattered on the wood. Behind him, through a open wooden doorway, a forested mountain slope shows a wooden mine headframe, smoke and small figures working among spoil heaps. A fire glows at the left edge.
